atoms.text: Mit dem conditional clause type 3 kann man beschreiben, was in der Vergangenheit hätte passieren können. Die Bedingung ist also unmöglich.
atoms.sound: Mit dem <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>conditional clause type 3</voice> kann man beschreiben, was in der Vergangenheit hätte passieren können. Die Bedingung ist also unmöglich. Im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>if-clause</voice> wird das <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>past perfect</voice> verwendet und im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>main clause</voice> wird <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>would, could</voice> oder <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>might</voice> plus <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>have</voice> plus <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>past participle</voice> verwendet.

elements: main clause: would / could / might + have + past participle

example.a: If it <m-yellow>hadn't closed</m-yellow> last week, they <m-blue>would have eaten</m-blue> at the Indian restaurant.
example.b: Wenn es letzte Woche nicht geschlossen hätte, hätten sie im indischen Restaurant gegessen.
example.sound: If it hadn't closed last week, they would have eaten at the Indian restaurant.

instruction.text: Welche Zeitform wird im conditional clause type 3 in welchem Satzteil verwendet? Ziehe aufeinander.
instruction.sound: Welche Zeitform wird im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>conditional clause type 3</voice> in welchem Satzteil verwendet? Ziehe aufeinander.

instruction.text: Entscheide: Handelt es sich hier um den conditional clause type 3?
instruction.sound: Entscheide: Handelt es sich hier um den <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>conditional clause type 3?</voice>

atoms.a: If Chloe had done her homework earlier, she could have met her best friend.
I would have talked to you if I had seen you at the Halloween party.
If Lino had planted an apple tree a few years ago, he could have eaten apples now.
If I have time to meet you after school, I will call you.
If my aunt moved to Chicago, I could see her more often.

instruction.text: Bringe die Teile des Satzes im conditional clause type 3 in die richtige Reihenfolge.
instruction.sound: Bringe die Teile des Satzes im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>conditional clause type 3 </voice> in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.b: If I hadn’t lost my camera, I ((could)) ((have)) ((looked)) at the photos.
If I had learned how to ice skate, I ((could)) ((have)) ((gone)) to the ice rink in December.
If I had bought the concert tickets last month, I ((would)) ((have)) ((seen)) the singer.

instruction.text: Vervollständige die Sätze im conditional clause type 3, indem du die jeweils passenden Verbformen in die Lücke schreibst.
instruction.sound: Vervollständige die Sätze im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>conditional clause type 3 </voice>, indem du die jeweils passenden Verbformen in die Lücke schreibst.

atoms.b: If I ((had_gone)) to Thailand last year, I could have swum in the sea.
If she had got into college in London, she ((would_have_moved)).
If I ((had_grown_up)) in Montreal, I ((would_have_known)) the sights.
